interventions.detail: Used docs/installation.md CPU recipe: python3.12 venv + torch/torchaudio 2.10.0 from the PyTorch CPU index before requirements.txt
apt-get install ffmpeg (not mentioned in the README)
README's wget of the example video gets HTTP 403 from the HF CDN redirect; curl -L on the same URL works
README's example --dest_text is not in the example video's transcript; used a sentence from total.srt
videoclipper.py stage 2: set audio_clipper.lang = lang (otherwise AttributeError 'lang')
videoclipper.py stage 2: move the clip written as <name>_noN.mp4 to the requested --output_file
Pre-download the funasr ModelScope models in setup.sh by instantiating AutoModel
